## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting passes
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Type checking passes
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Integration tests pass when applicable
- [ ] OpenAPI validation passes when API contracts change
- [ ] Build passes

## Security checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, `.env` files, or private keys are included
- [ ] Authorization and validation changes have test coverage
- [ ] Database changes include a reviewed migration
